note: Two sub-maps separated by a heavy double vertical rule at x~1170: LEFT panel covers 43rd-46th Sts between Av. J or Broadway and Avenue K (blocks 163/164/165, streets listed first four); RIGHT panel covers 24th-27th Sts between Avenue M and Avenue N (streets listed last four). Seam carries internal refs '38' (right panel side) and '0' brackets ('0' = nothing adjacent) along the left panel edges. Central High Public School (Negro) at 26th/Ave M; P. Levine & Co Cotton Pickery near 27th; Galveston & Western R.R. along right edge beside Avenue N; compass rose mid-left of right panel; scale bar bottom center.

Ursuline Academy and Convent occupies the whole giant block 41 (25th to 27th, Avenue N to Avenue O): convent, Presentation Chapel, dormitory, auditorium, laundry etc.; consequently 26th St crosses only east of Avenue O. Galveston & Western R.R. along left edge beside Avenue N. 'Street not open' segment top center. Quarter-block cross-refs 42 N.W./42 S.W./67 N.W./66 N.E./66 N.W. Fire-alarm box symbol (red circle) 45 at 27th & Avenue O 1/2 bottom right corner. Scale bar bottom right.

The Letitia Rosenberg Women's Home (pink brick, block 67 S.W.) and Public School 5th District (block 92 N.W.) between 24th and 25th. Cycle Park with grand stand and bleachers fills blocks 66 S.E./66 S.W. west of Avenue P from 25th to 27th (mostly open ground). Avenue P and P 1/2 corridors are unlabeled north of 25th. Fire-alarm box 45 (red circle) at bottom left corner (27th & O 1/2). Compass rose top left; scale bar bottom center.

Gulf of Mexico shoreline cuts diagonally across the NE corner; Murdoch's Bath House stands on posts out in the Gulf with an elevated walk from 23xx block; Olympia Entertainment Pavilion (large circular bldg, block 141 N.E.) near the beach; Lassaigne Hotel on 24th. Avenue R 1/2 marked 'Not Opened'. Right edge carries '70' (upper) and a '0' (lower, nothing adjacent seaward). Fire-alarm box 76 (red circle) at 25th near 2223. Large vacant beach-side blocks 141 N.W./142 N.W.

Everything east of Avenue N is the Garten Verein pleasure grounds (blocks 40 N.E./40 N.W., 39 N.E.): club house, prime dancing pavilion, bowling alley, bicycle house, kitchen, fountain, music stand, dove house; 28th St exists only west of Avenue N. Galveston & Western R.R. runs along Avenue N. Old Public School (not used) and Shiloh A.M.E. Church (Negro) on Avenue M block 15 N.W.; Macedonia Baptist Church (Negro) block 14 N.E. Fire-alarm box 43 (red circle) at top of left edge.

Western third is the Garten Verein continuation: block 40 S.E. with dancing pavilion, and 40 S.W. annotated 'Admission to this property refused. Grounds covered with dense growth of bushes & large trees' (two pink bldgs incl. tower); block 39 S.E. below 29th with servants' house/wood house; 28th St exists only east of the Verein grounds. Avenue O is wood block paved. Fire-alarm box 45 (red circle) at top center on 27th. Left-edge avenue corridor (Avenue N side) unlabeled on this sheet.

Fire Engine Co. No. 9 (engine & hose wagon) fronting Avenue P 1/2, block 90 N.W. Bottling works with storage on 27th (block 90 N.E.); macaroni factory ('Maccaroni Fact'y') with machine shop on 28th (block 90 S.E.); row of 'Negro Dwellings' block 115 N.E. Large vacant blocks 89 N.E./89 S.E. south of 29th. Fire-alarm box 52 (red circle) at 29th & Avenue Q.

Gulf of Mexico shoreline crosses the NE corner diagonally; '0' printed at top right and on right edge (nothing adjacent seaward). Bath house near the beach in block 140 S.E.; ware house (tin clad) on 27th; 'being built' bldg near 28th; row of 'Negro Dwellings' along Avenue R (block 140 N.W.). Large near-vacant blocks 140 S.W., 139 N.E., 139 S.E. 30th St marked 'Not Opened'.

Galveston & Western R.R. (dashed track) runs beside Avenue N. Block 39 N.W. (30th-31st) contains a private driveway lined with small lettered dwellings A-K. Av. N 1/2 ('Not Paved') opens only between 32nd and 33rd; blocks 38 N.E./38 S.E. and 39 N.W./39 S.W. run full width Avenue N to Avenue O without it. Avenue O is wood block paved. Fire-alarm box 47 (red circle) at 31st & Avenue N. Compass rose top center; scale bar bottom right.

Residential grid with substantial vacant ground (quarter-blocks 63 N.E./N.W./S.E./S.W., 64 N.W./S.W., 88 N.E./N.W., 89 N.W.). Avenue O is wood block paved (left edge). Fire-alarm box 51 (red circle) near 33rd & Avenue P 1/2 bottom right. Compass rose top left; scale bar bottom right.
